A security maintenance release.

## What changed

- **async-executor** is updated from 1.14.0 to 1.14.1. Its authors withdrew (yanked) 1.14.0 because of a use-after-free when a task woke while the executor shut down. It reaches HW Glance through the accessibility support of the window toolkit. Nothing looks or behaves differently.

The window and the collector speak the same protocol as 0.3.1 (protocol 6). Restart the collector after updating (the step below) so it runs the new build.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance/blob/v0.3.2/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.3.2-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user restart hwglanced
sudo systemctl restart hwglance-helper   # if you use the optional helper
hwglance-bar-widget update               # Omarchy only, if you installed the widget
```

For a first install, enable the services instead: `systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced` and, optionally, `sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper`, then `hwglance-bar-widget install` on Omarchy.

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed):

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.3.2-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.3.2-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Requirements and optional components are in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).
